title: Biggest Offline qualifiers Event for Pakistan Market
body:
For the first time, FFPL, Pakistan’s Tier 1 Free Fire pro league, introduced offline qualifiers across 6 cities selected based on user demographic data. Participation grew from 864 teams in FFPL 3 to 1,152 in FFPL 4. The Tier 2 FFSS (Soobai Series) also attracted \~900 teams, with 1 promotion slot to FFPL. We attracted >5.000 offline participants , >430K online reach each season

The offline format is the first layer touchpoint with users, creating stronger community engagement/retention and real competitive experiences. With a niche market rich in traditional culture & religious beliefs like Pakistan, combined with data and market research, this form of marketing brings high conversion rates in user sentiment & retention both externally and internally. 

MY ROLE & EXPERTISE: Conducted user and market research, translated data into actions, developed the tournament format, and aligned it with brand strategy and vision.
